# The list of withdrawn rights, vector 1.
#
# How a fleet takes a right away from an engineer or from an organisation. It is
# signed by the AUTHORISATION KEY of the fleet and not by an organisation: an
# organisation able to sign this list would publish one without its own people
# in it.
#
# The entries below are divided by `|` for the readability of this file only; in
# the document itself the list separator is a comma and the parts of an entry are
# divided by a colon.
serial = 7
issued_at = 1800000100
entries = engineer:eng-1:1800000000:left-the-fleet|organisation:acme:1800000050:contract-ended
signature_hex = abcd
canon_hex = 
wire = tessera-codes/v1/revocation-list;serial=7;issued_at=1800000100;entries=engineer:eng-1:1800000000:left-the-fleet,organisation:acme:1800000050:contract-ended
signed_wire = tessera-codes/v1/signed-revocation-list;;authorisation_signature=abcd
